LanguageData.LP_TitanSmite.label: divine punishment
LanguageData.LP_TitanSmite.description: Call down a bolt of lightning on a cell within 10 cells (the same fire explosion as a natural strike, plus a ring of EMP). Costs 30 divine might, cooldown 1 day. Can't penetrate mountains.
LanguageData.LP_TitanBreath.label: titanborn's breath
LanguageData.LP_TitanBreath.description: Blow a divine breath: every wound of all friendlies (same faction) within 5 cells of yourself loses 10 severity and stops bleeding. Costs 40 divine might, cooldown 2 days.
